title: Brelyna's Practice
description: Brelyna Maryon, a Dunmer student at the College of Winterhold, asks the player to serve as a test subject for her experimental Alteration spells. Her first attempt turns the player green, and her second attempt transforms them into various animals before finally succeeding. She rewards the player with a Resist Magic necklace and becomes available as a follower.

base_facts: I am a Dunmer student at the College of Winterhold studying Alteration magic.
I have been developing new spells and need someone to practice casting them on.
I would rather not ask J'zargo to be my test subject.

FIRST_SPELL_EFFECT: My first spell turned the player green. That was not supposed to happen, but the effect is temporary.
GREEN_WORN_OFF: The green effect has worn off. I am confident I can fix the spell if the player lets me try again.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I finally got the spell right after several mishaps. I gave the player a Resist Magic necklace as thanks, and we agreed to never speak of this again.
Brelyna's second attempt transforms the player into various animals before returning them to normal. She rewards the player with a Resist Magic necklace and the quest concludes.
Brelyna will also become a potential candidate for marriage , and can be asked to join you as a follower .
When you speak to her, she'll request your help: "We're all trying to become better mages, right?
